newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian apartment block explodes, at least 2 dead.
newsitem.headline: Russian apartment block explodes, at least 2 dead.

text.p: At least two people died and another three were injured when a powerful explosion damaged an apartment block in northwestern Russia on Friday, a government official said.

Rescue workers expected to find more bodies as they worked their way through the rubble in the town of Priozersk 120 km (80 miles) north of St Petersburg, a spokesman for the Emergencies Ministry said.
At least 33 people were missing, the official said.

Because of extreme cold weather, rescue work continued into the darkness of night in the heavily damaged building, as officials did not expect anyone trapped inside to survive more than one night, the spokesman said.
Officials said the blast, which occurred soon after midnight on Thursday, was probably caused by a leak in a gas stove.

In the first 11 months of this year, 13,719 people died in fires across Russia, and 12,876 were injured, a 10 percent rise on the year before, the Interior Ministry fire fighting service was reported as saying by Itar-Tass news agency.
Russian fire fighters complain that the number of fires in apartment blocks grows every winter as people try to get extra heat using makeshift electric devices or gas stoves.
